tools.name: craftybase_get_account
tools.description: Get the account name, currency, time zone and subscription plan for the API key. Good first call to check the connection. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/account.

tools.name: craftybase_list_materials
tools.description: List raw materials and supplies with stock on hand, available stock, reorder level, category and unit cost. Use state=all to include archived materials. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/materials.

tools.name: craftybase_get_material
tools.description: Get one material by id, with its stock levels, unit of measure, category and unit cost. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/materials/{id}.

tools.name: craftybase_list_material_inventory_adjustments
tools.description: List the stock history of one material: starting stock, purchases, manufactures, manual adjustments and stocktakes, oldest first. Read long histories in month windows with from and to. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/materials/{id}/inventory_adjustments.

tools.name: craftybase_list_products
tools.description: List finished products, including variations and stock levels. Use state=all to include archived products. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/products.

tools.name: craftybase_get_product
tools.description: Get one finished product by id, with its variations and stock levels. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/products/{id}.

tools.name: craftybase_list_components
tools.description: List components (sub-assemblies used to build other products) with stock levels and categories. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/components.

tools.name: craftybase_get_component
tools.description: Get one component by id, with its stock levels and category. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/components/{id}.

tools.name: craftybase_list_component_inventory_adjustments
tools.description: List the stock history of one component, oldest first: starting stock, manufactures, manual adjustments and stocktakes. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/components/{id}/inventory_adjustments.

tools.name: craftybase_list_manufactures
tools.description: List manufacture production runs, filtered by product, status and start-date range. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/manufactures.

tools.name: craftybase_get_manufacture
tools.description: Get one manufacture production run by id, with its line items. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/manufactures/{id}.

tools.name: craftybase_list_recipes
tools.description: List recipes with the full ingredient list and calculated costs. Cost fields appear only when the key's user can view financials. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/recipes.

tools.name: craftybase_list_expenses
tools.description: List purchases (expenses) with line items and supplier details, filtered by purchase date. A key without purchase access gets HTTP 403. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/expenses.

tools.name: craftybase_list_inventory_adjustments
tools.description: List inventory adjustments for the whole account (materials and components): how stock got to its current level. Filter by date window, costed rows and reason. To read one item's history, use the per-material or per-component tool. StockSmith API: GET /api/v1/inventory_adjustments.
